replies.author: SnowSX3
replies.body:
After getting a chat log check done. I've found that this player's behaviour has been completely fine.
So I'm going to deny this report.
Based off the evidence you have provided me, this player did not have any malicious intent, rather, he was just joking around.

If you feel this report has been handled incorrectly, feel free to contact a Senior Staff member, or you can contact me on Skype to discuss this further.  
My Skype is: SnowSX3
